prose: Mathemagician and author Robert Comber joins InnerVerse to discuss his upcoming book, The Lost Octave: Our Story in the Stars. After a spontaneous and jarring spiritual awakening, Robert began a Sirius study of various branches of metaphysics, culminating in a string of epiphanies that demonstrate a universal law of octaves, including an expansion of the I Ching from 64 to 72. In this episode you'll learn about the origins of the I Ching, the linguistic framework of the cosmos, numbers as qualities, and much more.
ext: Robert articulates the math and geometry behind his I Ching discovery, and we discuss astrological correspondences to hexagrams, how the Book of Changes itself is changing, the human story in star lore, Solfeggio frequencies, and how to make sense of conflicting esoteric systems of correspondence.
